methodology.ordering: Rotate implementations each round; new process per sample; verify every checksum
methodology.memory: Three separate peak-RSS measurements using /usr/bin/time; bytes, includes interpreter/runtime
methodology.cBaseline: Specialized int64 open-addressed hash tables; yyjson parse/type probe/write without August record binding
methodology.http: Same-host HTTP/1.1 loopback, keep-alive, closed-loop concurrency, JSON validated on every response; no TLS/auth/logging
